signal: GoodShip raised a $25M Series B led by Greenfield Partners and launched Laney, the industry's first AI transportation analyst, in January 2026.

email.body1:
Nick, saw GoodShip raised the $25M Series B and launched Laney, the first AI transportation analyst, in January.

Scaling that fast usually means more enterprise shippers in play than the team can cover before the new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for GoodShip off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nick, quick follow-up for GoodShip.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need for the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GoodShip needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nick, last bit of proof for GoodShip.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email logged to CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other Series-B logistics startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nick, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you ramp post-raise and roll out Laney, no problem at all. That stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B logistics motion? I will tailor it to GoodShip either way.
